# SCP-082 Abilities
This page describes the active abilities available to the object and the unique mechanics associated with it.
[textlink="General information about Fernand" link="Scp082About"]
## Airlock Prying Ability
Activating this ability on an airlock forces it open. This ability only works during the final stage of anger. Use it to open otherwise inaccessible airlocks.
[bold]To activate this ability, press E on the airlock, then stand still and do not move for a few seconds until the progress bar above your head finishes.[/bold]
## Corpse-Devouring Ability
Fernand devours a person's corpse when this ability is activated. This ability only works during the final stage of anger.
[bold]To activate this ability, right-click a corpse and press the "Eat" button in the context menu, then stand still and do not move for a few seconds until the progress bar above your head finishes.[/bold]
## Anger Mechanic
Over time, the object will grow hungry. As its hunger increases, its damage and attack speed are multiplied. Red pop-up text will tell you when you are hungry. During the final stage of anger, Security personnel can no longer grab Fernand.
This mechanic allows Fernand to begin an escape.
